answer: A proof-of-personhood semaphore: the gate is a biometric k-set. One human passes a liveness check, and the cipher of their face seals a set of twelve strangers, each holding one key share. Every identity must carry a share, and one human joins at most one set per epoch, so nectar for new identities flows at a capped rate. A bot farm needs a fresh face per clone: a hundred sybils cost a hundred enrolments at four dollars each, and one reused face voids the meadow of shares it touched. It runs like a nightclub where twelve enter together and nobody re-enters before the night closes.
